title: Case 001: Communal Garden and Hedge Maintenance Request
initial_request: Communal  garden full of weeds, hedge along side path overgrown, peice of no man's land at side  of my property  was going to be cleared  last summer and wasn't thanks
overview: The tenant reported weeds in the communal garden, an overgrown hedge along the side path, and an uncleared area beside the property. The landlord sought contractor quotes, approved the gardening works, and the tenant was updated that work was planned. The records later note a tree-removal job and confirm completion, with the landlord paying the contractor directly.
outcome: The communal garden works were completed; the landlord pays the contractor directly.
